content: Yɛsu kan'mɛnà akà alɔŋki nsambwaar
Ungö a indiir abi, Yɛsu kàfàmɛnà akalɔŋki ande kun'kɔɔl a ɛwà a Tibɛryade. Le, nde kàyàmɛnà aben akà ba:
Simɔn Petɔlà, Tuma - bàfàbel naa Didimɔ, Natanayɛl un'nsi Kana u Ngalilɛ, baan a Zebeday anà alɔŋki bɔ̈ɔ̈l bumwɛy bàkäl ikal imwɛy.
Simɔn Petɔlà kàtɛn a ba naa: « Mɛ, mɛ awin'kyà in'kàlwab nsö. » Ba bàtɛn a nde naa: « Bi ikyà anà ngye! » Laa bàtoo ba, bàbilà ba u bwaar, wɛɛ u mpib ayin, ba akundiir bàsiim anki.
Taaŋ làkäl lan'tyà, Yɛsu kàkäl aŋàmbar paa kun'kɔɔl a an'dà. Wɛɛ alɔŋki bàyöbà anki naa awun Yɛsu kàkäl.
Apan, Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: « Baan amɛ, nkye bɛ làwe anà undiir adyà? » Ba bun'fuur naa: « Ŋaa. »
Nde kàtɛn a ba naa: « Làtɔɔm an'tɛy u kɔɔ a ibaal a bwaar, waa bɛ làyàman. » Abun, waa ba bàtɔɔm ma, wɛɛ ba bàkwe anki munaan ma, ntɔn nsö yàkäl mbɔɔn.
Apan, un'lɔŋki kàfakweenà Yɛsu kàtɛn a Petɔlà naa: « Awà Mwol! » Pa kàwem Petɔlà naa Mwol kàkäl, nde kàbwäär ipfɛy, ntɔn nde kàkäl nsàpɔl, waa kàbü kan'dà.
Alɔŋki bumwɛy bàyi anà bwaar, ntɔn munaan an'tɛy màkäl aŋàyɔl a nsö: ba bàkäl anki kwɛl a nkankyel, isii a mɛtre nkam mwɛy.
Utaaŋ bàtɔlà ba u nkankyel, ba bàmɛn böl a an'kal a mbaa anà nsö udu, anà mampà.
Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: « Làtwääl nsö yumwɛy uboo a nsö lan'siim bɛ. »
Simɔn Petɔlà kàbilà u bwaar, kànaan an'tɛy u mɛɛn, ma màkäl aŋàyɔl a nsö an'köl an'köl: nkam mwɛy a an'kwem an'tyeen aŋitär. Itàkal naa ya yàkäl un'kàbɔ, an'tɛy màkaamà anki.
Yɛsu waa kabel: « Yää, làdi. » Akà un'lɔŋki mwɛy kàkwe anki mukun'fuul naa: « Ngye, ngye nà? » Ntɔn ba bàkiyöbà naa awà Mwol kàkäl.
Abun Yɛsu kàsin nde, nde kàwɛl mampà anà nsö, waa kakääb.
Ayi yàkäl mbalà yàtär ayà kàmɛnà Yɛsu akalɔŋki ande, fà kàwiyà nde uboo a akü.
Yɛsu anà Petɔlà

Ungö a udyà, Yɛsu kàfuul Simɔn Petɔlà naa: « Simɔn, mwan a Ywan, nkye ngye akyan'kwen aŋàsöön baar bà? » – Nde kàfuur naa: « Inye, Mwol, ngye akyàyöb ngye ŋakwo naa mɛ in'kyakwen. » Apan Yɛsu kàtɛn a nde naa: « Sey baan a in'kɔk amɛ. »
U mbalà yàyweel, Yɛsu kun'fuul naa: « Simɔn, mwan a Ywan, nkye ngye akyan'kwen? » Nde kàfuur naa: « Inye, Mwol, ngye akyàyöb naa mɛ in'kyakwen. » Yɛsu kàtɛn naa: « Kal nkyɛɛŋ a in'kɔk amɛ. »

U mbalà yàtär, nde kàtɛn a nde naa: « Simɔn, mwan a Ywan, nkye ngye akyan'kwen? » Petɔlà kàmɛn ngyɛb ntɔn kun'fuul Yɛsu mbalà yàtär naa: « Nkye ngye akyan'kwen? » Nde kun'fuur naa: « Mwol, ngye mbuur ayöb ndaa yanswà, ngye akyàyöb naa mɛ, mɛ in'kyakwen! » Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Sey in'kɔk amɛ.

Ndandaa, ndandaa, mɛ akyään: mpal kàkäl ngye un'tö, ngye ŋakwo kàfabäämà un'kab, ngye kàkyeenà ntsü yanswà kàkweenà ngye. Wɛɛ mpal asàbulà ngye un'nün, ngye asayaamà an'kɔɔ angye, waa mbuur asin usabäämà un'kab, nde sye usasyeenà ntsü mpa akwen ngye. »
Kàtɛn nde abà, Yɛsu kàkwen muswaŋ naa nkweel a Petɔlà isàkal aben ntɔn mupà Nzam làkoo. Ungö mutɛn abà, nde kàtɛn a nde naa: « Yan'läb! »
Yɛsu anà un'lɔŋki kàfakweenà nde
Petɔlà kàler ungö, kàmɛn nde un'lɔŋki kàfakweenà Yɛsu - nde akwà kàkàyiir kitɔl ande umpal bàkäl ba mudyà anà kun'fuul naa: « Mwol, nà asayälà? »
Mpal kun'mɛn Petɔlà, nde kàfuul Yɛsu naa: « Mwol, atöl nde, ininà isàkal? »
Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: « Isàkal naa mɛ in'kwen naa nde ukäl anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ tii mpal in'sàyà mɛ, a akà ngye mwo nkye? Ngye, yan'läb! »

Fà apan, làsaŋ làpää akatɔŋ naa un'lɔŋki awà usàkwà anki. Kyekà, Yɛsu kàtɛn anki naa un'lɔŋki awà usàkwà anki, wɛɛ nde kàtɛn naa: « Isàkal naa mɛ in'sàkwen naa nde ukäl tii mpal in'sàyà mɛ, a akà ngye mwo nkye? »
Un'lɔŋki nsil awà, wàmutà imbäl a indiir abi anà kàsön bya, bi ban'yöb naa imbäl ande kyà ndandaa.
Ntsülà
Yɛsu kàkyer indiir asin mbɔɔn. Yàlàkal naa bàsön bya imwɛy imwɛy, mɛ in'sii ikal kyàlàkal anki musà in'kaan myanswà bàlàsɔn.
